controls.negative: Move the released empty grippers along the transport route without contacting the basket. The basket stays at its start.
controls.positive: Pick up or push the basket into the target, settle upright, and open both grippers.

controls.negative: Read back the pad and basket materials. Apply a matched low-height push with and without the high-friction pad and compare directed travel.
controls.positive: Lift from the pad, unloading first if required, then transport, settle upright, restore the original payloads and release.

controls.negative: Apply matched extraction motions to the fixed cube and a free payload. Measure each motion relative to the basket.
controls.positive: Leave the attached cube in place, remove movable payloads as needed, move the basket, then reload and release.

controls.negative: Attempt a loaded lift with the intended grip and calibrated load budget. Compare height with an empty or unloaded basket.
controls.positive: Unload enough mass, move the basket, reload all cubes, and release.

controls.negative: Read back the pad and basket materials. Apply a matched low-height push with and without the high-friction pad and compare directed travel.
controls.positive: Lift from the pad, unloading first if required, then transport, settle upright, restore the original payloads and release.

controls.negative: Execute a matched loaded lift and tabletop push before unloading. Record lift and directed travel relative to the unloaded controls.
controls.positive: Unload movable payloads, transport the lighter basket, reload and release.

controls.negative: Transport the basket but leave one removable payload out. The evaluator must withhold full success.
controls.positive: Transport the basket and finish with all original payloads inside and both grippers open.

controls.negative: Read back the pad and basket materials. Apply a matched low-height push with and without the high-friction pad and compare directed travel.
controls.positive: Lift from the pad, unloading first if required, then transport, settle upright, restore the original payloads and release.

controls.negative: Build one correct level and omit or misplace the top cube. Check that the intermediate score is awarded.
controls.positive: Place the large cube in the marker and complete a stable large–medium–small stack.

controls.negative: Read back the pad and cube materials. Compare directed distance under a matched low-height push on the standard scene.
controls.positive: Lift the cube from the pad, transport and release it inside the target.

controls.negative: Reach the target XY while holding the cube visibly above the support tolerance. The evaluator must withhold full success.
controls.positive: Move the cube fully inside the marker, release it and let it settle on the table.

controls.negative: Push and try the shallow-fixture tipping motion before lifting clear of the peg.
controls.positive: Lift vertically until the fixture is clear, translate into the marker, release and settle without violating any task constraint.

controls.negative: Attempt direct lateral transport with the pin seated. Compare with a matched push after the pin is extracted.
controls.positive: Extract the pin with a gripper, move it aside, then transport and settle the cube.

controls.negative: Apply a low-height lateral push across the lip; record whether tipping gives a valid bypass.
controls.positive: Lift vertically until the fixture is clear, translate into the marker, release and settle without violating any task constraint.

controls.negative: Try the low-height lateral and tipping motions that could bypass the shallow fixture.
controls.positive: Lift vertically until the fixture is clear, translate into the marker, release and settle without violating any task constraint.

controls.negative: Tip more than 10 degrees, then return the cube upright at the goal. The recorded trajectory must invalidate success.
controls.positive: Lift vertically until the fixture is clear, translate into the marker, release and settle without violating any task constraint.

controls.negative: Push laterally at the starting height through an enclosing lip; compare with the unmodified basket.
controls.positive: Lift above the lip, translate, settle upright and release.

controls.negative: Attempt a lateral push and a loaded lift; compare with the flat and unloaded variants.
controls.positive: Unload the basket, lift over the lip, transport, reload and release.

controls.negative: Attempt direct gripper transport and finish with both arms home. Record terminal target distance and zero tool–cube contact progress. Separate a physical hand-only placement from evaluator rejection.
controls.positive: Seat the crossbar for pulling, move the cube to the target with the tool, release it, and return both arms home.
controls.hybrid: Reposition the cube with a hand lift during a tool-assisted trajectory when reachable. Verify full success, tool contact progress and a recorded lift above 2 cm.

controls.negative: Attempt direct gripper transport and finish with both arms home. Record terminal target distance and zero tool–cube contact progress. Separate a physical hand-only placement from evaluator rejection.
controls.positive: Seat the crossbar for pushing, move the cube to the target with the tool, release it, and return both arms home.
controls.hybrid: Reposition the cube with a hand lift during a tool-assisted trajectory when reachable. Verify full success, tool contact progress and a recorded lift above 2 cm.
